pages.title: Superconducting Coil
pages.text: A coil of wire cooled below its critical temperature, where electrical resistance drops to exactly zero. Current set running in it circulates forever, and the magnetic field it produces is steady as bedrock. It is frosted with cold and pulls gently at anything iron nearby.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Winding neutronium wire through a bath of Superfluid Helium in the Metamaterial Weaver, I watched the resistance fall off a cliff to zero. Weeks later the current was still running. Derelict stations kept spares, I later noticed.
